events.title: Great Pyramid of Giza completed
events.fact: Workers stacked more than two million stone blocks into place.
events.why: It stood as the tallest building on Earth for millennia.
events.summary: The Great Pyramid was built as a tomb for the pharaoh Khufu. Crews moved over two million blocks without wheels or engines. It remained the tallest structure on Earth for a very long time.
